answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The orchard panel is drawn blind, the thread escrow settles at close, and island lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 22% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 249 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
